src/content/i18n/pages.yaml.f7ad846bdf83b59f: The site sets a technical cookie to remember your selected language, analytics cookies (Google Analytics and Yandex Metrica), and an advertising cookie (Meta Pixel). Analytics and the pixel start on the first page load. You can opt out using the "Cookie settings" link at the bottom of the site. If you do, they won't run from your next page load. Yandex Metrica records sessions, including cursor movement, scrolling and clicks. We exclude the enquiry form from these recordings, so its contents are never recorded. The pixel tells Meta when you view a page, send an enquiry, message us or place an order. This helps us see which Facebook and Instagram ads bring in customers. The form contents are not shared with the pixel. If you continue to our Telegram bot after visiting the site and send an enquiry there, our server tells Meta only that an enquiry was sent, not its contents or your contact details. Your cart is stored in your browser's memory (localStorage) and is not sent to our server on its own. An anonymous identifier is stored in your browser's memory and in our own visitor_id cookie. It is sent to our server when you search for parts by VIN. We use it to link your enquiries in our CRM to the cars you've searched for by VIN, so our manager can see which car you have straight away. If you opt out, the identifier and cookie are deleted.

Na kraju Vam pokazujemo uzrok na automobilu i jasno objašnjavamo šta smo pronašli. Ako je potrebna popravka, odmah pripremamo predračun.

Koliko košta: očitavanje grešaka je besplatno. Dijagnostika se naplaćuje tek ako treba rasklopiti deo ili postaviti automobil na uređaj za ispitivanje. Cenu saopštavamo pre početka radova, ne na kraju.

First, we ask about the symptoms: when they started, what conditions they occur in, and what work has been done recently. Sometimes that already points us in the right direction. A knock that happens only when the engine is cold may have a different cause from one that's always there.

Then we scan all the car's control units. A fault in the ABS or comfort control module can often explain the issue you're experiencing. Next, we inspect the car: check for play on the ramp, examine components under load, and, if needed, measure pressure or use an oscilloscope.

At the end, we'll show you the cause on the car and explain it in plain English. If repairs are needed, we'll give you a quote straight away.

How much does it cost? Reading fault codes is free. We only charge for diagnostics if we need to dismantle a component or put the car on a test bench. We'll tell you the price before we start, not after.

src/content/works/BMW 116D/index.md.038c4780f7f61f7b: BMW 116d: coolant, engine mount and EGR valve
src/content/works/BMW 116D/index.md.39fed69eb1231d8f:
**BMW 116d at our garage in Belgrade.**

This time, a BMW 116d came in for a comprehensive service and to address several issues. BMWs require a good understanding of their engine designs and careful attention to detail. We don't just replace parts, we look for the cause of the failure.

**What work did we carry out on the BMW 116d?**

1. **Coolant replacement.** We replaced the coolant to ensure the engine cooling system works properly. Replacing coolant on time helps protect system components from corrosion, maintain the correct operating temperature and prevent the engine from overheating.
2. **Lubrication of the EGR back-pressure valve in the exhaust system.** We serviced the exhaust back-pressure valve, which is part of the exhaust gas recirculation system and is located in the exhaust pipe. This component helps regulate exhaust back pressure and the operation of the EGR system in BMW diesel engines. Over time, the mechanism can become dirty, stick or stop working properly. We lubricated the valve mechanism as needed.
3. **Engine mount replacement.** We replaced the worn engine mount on the BMW 116d. Engine mounts secure the powertrain and reduce the amount of vibration transferred to the body. When they wear out, they can cause excessive vibration, discomfort in the cabin and added stress on other components.
4. **The crankshaft torsional vibration damper needs replacing.** During the service, we also found that the crankshaft torsional vibration damper will need to be replaced. This component helps absorb vibrations and keep the auxiliary belt drive running smoothly. We don't recommend putting off replacement of a worn damper, as it can fail and cause further damage and costly repairs.
src/content/works/BMW 116D/index.md.afe790aa582bfab0: BMW 116d: antifriz, nosač motora i EGR klapna
src/content/works/BMW 116D/index.md.ba2276e74fbe599f:
**BMW 116d u našem auto servisu u Beogradu.**

Ovog puta nam je dovezen BMW 116d kome su bili potrebni sveobuhvatan servis i otklanjanje nekoliko kvarova. Kod BMW vozila važno je poznavati specifičnosti motora i pažljivo pregledati svaki deo. Ne menjamo samo delove, već tražimo uzrok njihovog kvara.

**Koje radove smo obavili na BMW 116d?**

1. **Zamena antifriza.** Zamenili smo rashladnu tečnost kako bi sistem za hlađenje motora pravilno radio. Pravovremena zamena antifriza štiti delove sistema od korozije, održava optimalnu radnu temperaturu i sprečava pregrevanje motora.
2. **Podmazivanje povratnog ventila EGR-a u izduvnom sistemu.** Servisirali smo povratni ventil sistema za recirkulaciju izduvnih gasova, koji se nalazi u izduvnoj cevi. Ovaj deo reguliše protivpritisak izduvnih gasova i rad EGR sistema kod dizel motora BMW vozila. Vremenom mehanizam može da se zaprlja, zaglavljuje i ne radi kako treba. Podmazali smo mehanizam ventila.
3. **Zamena nosača motora.** Zamenili smo dotrajali nosač motora na BMW 116d. Nosači motora drže motor i menjač i smanjuju prenos vibracija na karoseriju. Kada se istroše, mogu da izazovu pojačane vibracije, neprijatnosti u kabini i dodatno opterećenje drugih delova.
4. **Utvrđeno je da treba zameniti prigušivač torzionih oscilacija.** Tokom servisa utvrdili smo i da će biti potrebna zamena prigušivača torzionih oscilacija radilice. Ovaj deo prigušuje oscilacije i omogućava stabilan rad remenskog pogona pomoćnih uređaja. Ne preporučujemo odlaganje zamene dotrajalog prigušivača, jer njegovo oštećenje može da izazove dodatne kvarove i skupe popravke.

src/content/works/audi-a3/index.md.3ed9c58422377aa3: Veliki servis za Audi A3 1.5 TFSI
src/content/works/audi-a3/index.md.68da40ad2168bbc3:
Audi A3 sa benzinskim motorom **1.5 TFSI od 150 KS** i robotizovanim menjačem DQ200 stigao je u naš auto servis u Beogradu na veliki servis. Zamenili smo zupčasti kaiš.

Na osnovu dijagnostike zamenili smo i električnu pumpu rashladnog sistema. To je poseban sklop i njena zamena nije povezana sa velikim servisom ni sa zupčastim kaišem. Dijagnostika je pokazala da je pumpa izgubila kapacitet i da više ne cirkuliše rashladnu tečnost kako treba. Nismo čekali da to utiče na temperaturu motora. Nakon radova sipali smo nov antifriz.

Usput smo uradili i mali servis: zamenili smo motorno ulje i sve potrebne filtere.

Zatim smo se pozabavili menjačem. DQ200 je robotizovani menjač sa suvim kvačilima. Zamenili smo ulje u mehaničkom delu i radnu tečnost u mehatronici. Naša preporuka za ovaj menjač je jednostavna: ulje i mehatroniku treba servisirati najmanje jednom na **60.000 km**. Uz ovakav interval, menjač duže traje i ređe dolazi na skupu popravku.
src/content/works/audi-a3/index.md.7773b8495fe4b135:
This Audi A3, with a **150 hp 1.5 TFSI petrol engine** and a DQ200 dual-clutch gearbox, came to our Russian-speaking car service in Belgrade for a major service. We replaced the timing belt.

Diagnostics also showed that the electric coolant pump needed replacing. It's a separate component, and replacing it has nothing to do with the major service or the timing belt. The pump had lost efficiency and was no longer circulating coolant properly, so we didn't wait for that to affect the engine's operating temperature. We refilled the system with fresh coolant after the work.

We also carried out a minor service, changing the engine oil and all the necessary filters.

Next, the gearbox. The DQ200 is a dry-clutch dual-clutch transmission. We changed the oil in its mechanical section and the hydraulic fluid in the mechatronics unit. Our recommendation for this gearbox is simple: service both the oil and the mechatronics unit at least every **60,000 km**. This helps the gearbox last longer and reduces the chance of an expensive repair.

src/content/works/audi-s4-veliki-servis/.2b37f9665654a896:
U **CarLab** nam je stigao **Audi S4 iz 2012. godine** sa benzinskim motorom **3.0 TFSI**. Uradili smo veliki servis, zamenili sva četiri lanca razvoda i servisirali automatizovani **S tronic** menjač (DSG).

Šta smo uradili:

- Zamenili smo sva četiri lanca razvoda i komplete lančanog pogona.
- Zamenili smo zaptivke i semeringe motora.
- Proverili smo dostupne sklopove motora.
- Servisirali smo S tronic menjač.
- Proverili smo kako automobil radi nakon popravke.

Kod motora **3.0 TFSI**, lančani pogon razvoda nalazi se sa strane menjača, pa zamena lanaca traje dugo. Vremenom se lanci istežu, a zatezači i vođice habaju. Znaci za uzbunu su **metalni zvuk pri hladnom startu**, greške sinhronizacije bregastih osovina, neravnomeran rad motora i upozorenja na instrument tabli.

Pošto smo već rastavili motor, zamenili smo i zaptivke i semeringe kako bismo sprečili moguća curenja ulja. Za ovaj posao potreban je specijalan alat i **precizno podešavanje faze razvoda**.

S tronic menjač smo servisirali tečnostima prema specifikaciji proizvođača. Redovan servis pomaže da menjač menja brzine glatko i smanjuje njegovo habanje. Motor i menjač smo sredili tokom jedne posete.

src/content/works/audi-s4-veliki-servis/.bd11057502dbe193: Audi S4 3.0 TFSI: timing chain replacement and S tronic service
src/content/works/audi-s4-veliki-servis/.d1d271cba8d56cc6:
A **2012 Audi S4** with a **3.0 TFSI** petrol engine came to **CarLab** for a major service (**veliki servis**), including replacement of all four timing chains and servicing of the **S tronic** (DSG) transmission.

Work carried out:

- Replaced all four timing chains and the complete timing chain drive kits.
- Replaced the engine gaskets and seals.
- Checked the accessible engine components.
- Serviced the S tronic transmission.
- Checked the car's operation after the repairs.

On the **3.0 TFSI**, the timing chain drive is located on the transmission side, so replacing the chains is a time-consuming job. Over time, the chains stretch and the tensioners and guides wear out. Signs can include **metallic noise on a cold start**, camshaft timing faults, rough running, and warning lights on the dashboard.

Since the engine was already apart, we also replaced the gaskets and seals to address potential sources of oil leaks. This job requires specialist tools and **precise camshaft timing**.

We serviced the S tronic transmission using fluids that meet the manufacturer's specifications. Regular servicing helps maintain smooth gear changes and reduce transmission wear. We completed the engine and transmission work in one visit.

This BMW 118d with an N47 diesel engine and around **380,000 km** on the clock came to our garage in Belgrade. It had been brought over from Denmark, and the owner had recently bought it. They started with a comprehensive service and fixing the issues that had already come up. That's the right way to start after buying a used car.

We began with a full routine service: engine oil and all filters (oil, air, cabin and fuel). The fuel filter is especially important on the N47: the condition of the fuel system directly affects how smoothly the engine runs and how long its components last.

Next, we checked the suspension and brakes. We replaced the flexible boots, brake discs and pads. On a high-mileage used car, the brakes are among the first things to check. The worn parts needed replacing so the car would be safe to drive.

We found a leak at the rear differential, replaced the seal and stopped the oil loss. On cars with this kind of mileage, the differential, seals and the rest of the drivetrain need extra attention.

At 380,000 km, you can't get everything done in one visit. We'll bring the car back into shape step by step: a full diagnostic check, a list of priorities, then the engine, brakes, suspension and drivetrain in turn. That's exactly how we recommend approaching a used car after purchase.

Our technicians know the N47 diesel well. With proper servicing, this kind of mileage doesn't mean the engine is done for, but you can't put off repairs or miss service intervals.

Zatim smo pregledali trap i kočnice. Zamenili smo elastične čaure, kočione diskove i pločice. Na polovnom automobilu sa velikom kilometražom kočnice se proveravaju među prvima. Ovde su istrošeni delovi morali da se zamene kako bi automobil mogao bezbedno da se vozi.

**This 2019 Range Rover Sport PHEV** with a **2.0 Ingenium** petrol engine came in for a major service (**veliki servis**) and timing system work. It's a plug-in hybrid, with an electric motor and high-voltage battery in addition to the petrol engine, so the work has to be carried out in a specific order.

Before any work that requires the hybrid system to be de-energised, the high-voltage supply is disconnected **in accordance with the manufacturer's procedure**. Disconnecting the regular battery is not enough: the high-voltage battery must be isolated using a separate procedure, then checked to confirm there is no voltage. The low-voltage system is also checked and disconnected.

Engine work carried out:

- Checked the valve timing mechanism.
- Serviced and replaced timing drive components as required by the engine design and manufacturer's procedure.
- Checked the cooling system.
- Checked seals and connections.
- Checked the engine's overall condition.

src/content/works/vw-golf/index.md.2f86d51b05f3ffcb:
Volkswagen Golf iz 2017. godine sa 7-stepenim automatskim menjačem **DSG DQ381** došao je u naš auto servis u Beogradu na sveobuhvatan servis i otklanjanje nekoliko kvarova.

Tokom servisa zamenili smo poklopac ventila zbog curenja ulja, ponovo zaptivili dizne, uradili mali servis motora, zamenili ulje i filter u DSG menjaču i očistili kočione čeljusti.

Posebnu pažnju posvetili smo menjaču DSG DQ381. Reč je o savremenom 7-stepenom menjaču sa dva kvačila, kod kojeg je važno redovno menjati ulje i filter. Vremenom ulje gubi svoja svojstva, u njemu se nakupljaju produkti habanja, što utiče na rad mehatronike, hidrauličnog sistema i kvačila. Redovna zamena ulja omogućava glatko menjanje brzina i smanjuje rizik od skupih popravki DSG menjača.

U menjač smo sipali ulje **MOTUL** odgovarajuće specifikacije, a i u motor smo sipali MOTUL. Kvalitet motornog i ulja za menjač direktno utiče na radni vek automobila.

U okviru malog servisa zamenili smo motorno ulje i potrebne filtere. Redovna zamena ulja posebno je važna kod Volkswagen motora sa turbinom: podmazuje delove, odvodi toplotu i štiti turbinu od prevremenog habanja.

Zamenili smo poklopac ventila jer je stari počeo da propušta ulje. Takva curenja se vremenom pojačavaju i dovode do prljanja motora. Ponovo smo zaptivili i dizne: dobro zaptivanje spojeva važno je za bezbedan rad sistema za gorivo.

Očistili smo i kočione čeljusti od prljavštine i korozije. Zaglavljeni pokretni delovi dovode do neravnomernog habanja kočionih pločica, pregrevanja diskova i neobičnih zvukova pri kočenju.

A 2017 Volkswagen Golf with a 7-speed **DSG DQ381** dual-clutch transmission came to our Belgrade workshop for a full service and repairs to several faults.

We replaced the valve cover to fix an oil leak, resealed the fuel injectors, carried out a minor engine service, changed the oil and filter in the DSG gearbox, and cleaned the brake calipers.

We paid particular attention to the DSG DQ381. This modern 7-speed transmission has two clutches, so changing the oil and filter on time is essential. Over time, the oil loses its protective properties and collects wear debris, which can affect the mechatronics, hydraulic system and clutches. Regular oil changes help keep gear shifts smooth and reduce the risk of costly DSG repairs.

We filled the gearbox with **MOTUL** transmission oil to the correct specification, and used MOTUL engine oil as well. The quality of both engine and transmission oil directly affects the car's service life.

As part of the minor service, we changed the engine oil and the required filters. Timely oil changes are especially important for Volkswagen turbocharged engines: the oil lubricates moving parts, carries away heat and protects the turbocharger from premature wear.

We replaced the valve cover because the old one had started leaking oil. Leaks can get worse over time and lead to engine contamination. We also resealed the fuel injectors, as tight connections are essential for the fuel system to operate safely.

We cleaned the brake calipers to remove dirt and corrosion. Seized moving parts can cause uneven pad wear, overheated discs and unusual noises when braking.

src/content/works/zamena-masla-v-dsg-dq-.2894b65e116d77e6:
Changing the oil in a **DSG DQ381** is an important part of gearbox maintenance that should not be overlooked.

This time, we carried out a scheduled oil change. The customer chose **MEYLE** oil, which we filled along with completing the rest of the required maintenance.

The DQ381 is a modern seven-speed DSG dual-clutch transmission with wet clutches, fitted to many Volkswagen, Audi, Škoda and SEAT models. With regular maintenance, it can keep running for years without serious problems.

The same goes for other common DSG transmissions, the DQ250 and DQ200. They have different designs and service schedules, but the condition of the oil and timely maintenance directly affect the gearbox's lifespan, as well as how the mechatronic unit and clutches work.

We recommend looking beyond the official service schedule and taking actual driving conditions into account. If the service history is unknown, it's definitely not a good idea to drive 100,000 to 150,000 km on the same oil. At **100,000 km**, it's worth finding out when and how the gearbox was last serviced. For the DQ381 and DQ250, an oil change is usually advisable well before then.

Fresh, high-quality oil maintains its properties across a range of temperatures and loads, lubricates the gearbox and helps dissipate heat. This helps put off costly repairs.

Bought a used car and don't know when the DSG DQ381, DQ250 or DQ200 was last serviced? Have the gearbox condition and service history checked before problems arise.
src/content/works/zamena-masla-v-dsg-dq-.a097fe551892d149:
Zamena ulja u **DSG DQ381** je deo održavanja menjača koji ne bi trebalo zanemariti.

Ovog puta smo uradili redovnu zamenu: klijent je izabrao ulje **MEYLE**, sipali smo ga i obavili sve ostalo što je bilo potrebno.

DQ381 je moderan sedmostepeni DSG menjač sa mokrim kvačilima, koji se ugrađuje u mnoge modele Volkswagen, Audi, Škoda i SEAT. Ako ga redovno održavate, ovakav menjač može dugo da traje bez ozbiljnih problema.

Isto važi i za druge česte DSG menjače, DQ250 i DQ200. Njihova konstrukcija i intervali održavanja se razlikuju, ali stanje ulja i redovno održavanje direktno utiču na vek menjača, rad mehatronike i kvačila.

Savetujemo Vam da se ne oslanjate samo na propisane intervale, već i na stvarne uslove vožnje. Ako ne znate istoriju održavanja, ne bi trebalo da vozite 100–150 hiljada kilometara sa istim uljem. Na svakih **100 000 km** ima smisla bar proveriti kada je i kako menjač održavan, a ulje u DQ381 i DQ250 obično vredi zameniti znatno ranije.

Kvalitetno sveže ulje zadržava potrebna svojstva pri različitim temperaturama i opterećenjima, podmazuje i odvodi toplotu. Tako se odlaže potreba za skupom popravkom.

Kupili ste polovan automobil, a ne znate kada je poslednji put održavan DSG DQ381, DQ250 ili DQ200? Proverite stanje menjača i njegovu istoriju na vreme.
